features.name: Repository state reconciliation
features.notes: Rewrote CLAUDE.md, STATUS.json, docs/architecture.md, docs/progress.md, docs/design.md, HANDOFF.md. Updated active skill files. Corrected broken architecture reference. No application code — docs/state only. Correction pass (2026-05-24): restored import scope as back-011, made status consistent across all trackers, corrected carryover docs.

features.name: Project scaffold and git init
features.notes: Created root .gitignore (Python, Node, env, logs, macOS artifacts). Scaffolded api/ (app/models, schemas, routers, services, alembic/versions, tests with all placeholder .py files) and web/ (src/app routes, components, lib). Git already initialized (root commit on main). No application logic — empty/minimal placeholders only.

features.name: FastAPI setup — config, database, main
features.notes: Created pyproject.toml, .env.example, app/config.py, app/database.py, app/main.py, app/deps.py, and app/__init__.py. Added APIRouter stubs to all 6 router files and a foundation smoke test in tests/test_app.py. Created backend venv and installed dev dependencies. Final verified commands from api/: ruff pass, mypy pass, pytest pass. Test bootstrap no longer depends on an untracked local .env because tests seed required env vars in conftest.py before importing app.config.

features.name: JWT auth — login endpoint and token verification
features.notes: app/auth.py: bcrypt hashing (hash_password, verify_password), JWT encode/decode (create_access_token, verify_token). app/routers/auth.py: POST /auth/login returns JWT on valid credentials, 401 on bad creds; GET /auth/me protected test endpoint. tests/test_auth.py: 3 tests (login success, wrong password → 401, protected endpoint without token → 401). Switched from passlib[bcrypt] to bcrypt directly (passlib incompatible with bcrypt>=5).

features.name: SQLAlchemy models and initial Alembic migration
features.notes: models/book.py, tag.py, loan.py, label_template.py. alembic init, env.py, 0001_initial_schema migration.

features.name: pytest async fixtures with isolated test database
features.notes: tests/conftest.py: test_engine (session-scoped, drop/create schema), db_session, client (ASGITransport, DB override), auth_client (pre-authenticated). Test database created: personal_library_test on local PostgreSQL 18 (Homebrew).

features.name: ISBN EAN-13 validation and normalization
features.notes: services/isbn_validate.py: normalize_isbn(), validate_isbn13(). 6 unit tests.

features.name: ISBN lookup — Open Library with Google Books fallback
features.notes: services/isbn_lookup.py: lookup_isbn(), BookData dataclass. respx mocks for 3 integration tests.

features.name: Books CRUD with ISBN lookup endpoint
features.notes: schemas/book.py, routers/books.py. Endpoints: POST /books/, GET /books/, GET /books/{id}, PATCH /books/{id}, DELETE /books/{id}, GET /books/lookup/{isbn}. 6 tests.

features.name: Tags and loans CRUD
features.notes: schemas/tag.py, schemas/loan.py, routers/tags.py, routers/loans.py. Tags: create/list/update/delete. Loans: create, list (open_only filter), return endpoint.

features.name: Label templates and PDF generation
features.notes: schemas/label_template.py, services/pdf_labels.py (reportlab), routers/labels.py. POST /labels/generate returns application/pdf with Dewey+title+barcode per book.

features.name: BibTeX and CSV export
features.notes: services/bibtex_io.py, services/csv_io.py, routers/export.py. GET /export/bibtex and GET /export/csv. Empty catalog returns valid empty file.

features.name: CSV and BibTeX import
features.notes: MVP scope per approved spec (Module 6). CSV upload with column mapping (POST /import/csv). BibTeX upload to import existing catalog from Zotero/Mendeley (POST /import/bibtex). Part of routers/export.py or new routers/import_.py.

features.name: Next.js 15 scaffold — Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, auth middleware
features.notes: web/: create-next-app, shadcn init, @zxing/browser install. src/lib/api.ts, src/lib/auth.ts (server actions, httpOnly cookie). src/middleware.ts redirects unauthenticated users to /login.

features.name: Login page
features.notes: web/src/app/login/page.tsx. Client component. POST to /auth/login, stores token via server action, redirects to /catalog.

features.name: Book catalog page — grid/list view with search and filters
features.notes: app/catalog/page.tsx. Search bar, tag/language/loan-status filters, sort controls. Grid (covers) and list toggle.

features.name: Book detail page
features.notes: app/catalog/[id]/page.tsx. All book fields, tag badges, loan history, edit and delete actions.

features.name: Book registration with ISBN scanner
features.notes: app/books/new/page.tsx + components/isbn-scanner.tsx (@zxing/browser). ISBN entry triggers /books/lookup/{isbn} pre-fill. Manual entry fallback.

features.name: Loans page
features.notes: app/loans/page.tsx. Open loans list with days elapsed, return action, loan history per book.

features.name: Label generation page
features.notes: app/labels/page.tsx. Select books, choose template, POST /labels/generate, trigger PDF download.
